name: Lost in the Thicket Things

angles.text: As a herbalist, you may recognize Ardin Grassman's gift for sensing plants and herbs. He often climbs difficult terrain to gather rare plants for alchemy.
As a druid, you may recognize Ardin's gift for sensing plants. The wildlife near the dig sites has grown agitated, disturbing the balance of the wilds.

faq.answer: Ardin Grassman gathers herbs and has a rare instinct for sensing plants. He often searches cliffs and peaks for wild flora to supply his wife's alchemy. Rumors of towering grasses drew him toward an excavation site.
Ardin heard an excavation crew describe towering grasses unlike any they had seen. His instinct for unusual plants drew him out to see them, and he did not return home.
faq.q: Why did Ardin wander off into the wild?

faq.answer: Ardin went toward the nearby Excavation Sites after hearing a passing crew's report. Search the dig sites where the crew set up camp.
Ardin reached the excavation camp as local wildlife turned aggressive. Giant spiders and other beasts ambushed the crew, trapping Ardin with them until travelers arrived to help.
faq.q: What happened to Ardin at the excavation site?

aliases: who gives lost in the thicket things
faq.answer: Ardin's wife, an alchemist, is looking for him. He gathered herbs for her shelves, but did not return after investigating reports of strange grass. So she asked travelers to find him.
The cause of the wildlife's sudden agitation near the excavation sites is unknown. Aggressive creatures, especially spiders, swarmed and overwhelmed the dig team.
faq.q: Why did the wildlife attack the excavation crew?

sections.body: Ardin Grassman's alchemist wife asks you to find her missing husband. He has a keen sense for nature and often braves cliffs and distant wilds to gather herbs and plants for her work. When an excavation crew spoke of towering grasses unlike any they had seen, Ardin's curiosity drew him toward the site.
sections.title: A Forager's Calling

sections.body: Ardin reached the excavation site and found the crew in danger. The surrounding land had agitated the local wildlife, and hostile spiders swarmed the dig team. Ardin and the crew were trapped by the attacking beasts until travelers came to their aid.
sections.title: Ambush at the Dig Site

summary: Ardin Grassman is missing near an excavation site after following word of towering grasses. His alchemist wife asks travelers to find him, as dangerous wildlife has attacked the crew.
attribution: In-game quest text: Lost in the Thicket Things
